searches.reason: Develop controlled history interventions that distinguish sustained recent preferences from isolated purchases and superficial associations. Compare removing, reordering, or replacing interactions against matched controls, then measure ranking changes. Validate perturbations on training-history prefixes, and connect failures to sequence encoding, positional signals, or popularity dependence without claiming causal identification.
searches.query: sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation history perturbation recency repeated preferences isolated interactions counterfactual sensitivity matched controls 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Build evidence-grounded recommendation audits for unsupported equipment assumptions, explicit compatibility conflicts, and potentially redundant purchases using only histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Seek methods that distinguish documented support, contradiction, and insufficient information; purchase history alone cannot establish ownership or need satisfaction. Calibrate these labels against the twenty users’ qualitative feedback without treating simulated traits as observed.
searches.query: recommendation evaluation evidence grounded compatibility complementary substitute redundant purchases product descriptions selective prediction abstention human feedback 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics predict actionable ranking failures instead of merely reporting training separation. Compare loader-negative margins with fixed, training-only prefix retrieval and full-catalog unseen-item rankings; quantify uncertainty by user and dataset and test robustness to candidate sampling and popularity. Keep the pinned validation macro HR@10 as the selection criterion and budget diagnostic computation explicitly.
searches.query: recommender diagnostic metric validation sampled negatives versus full catalog ranking popularity bias bootstrap uncertainty subgroup sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026
